job: check a rendered page for its frame, its reduced-motion first screen, its heading order, its tab order and its page metadata

distinct_from.why: This tool itself: the rule rows (read-data/page-craft-rules.json), the reduced-motion second pass (do-work/critique-a-page.mjs), the README and the test of the measures this contract claims.
Its test_map_page_metadata maps the metadata of a saved conversation's page into a transcript; it does not judge whether a rendered page carries a title, language, viewport and description.

phrasings: check a rendered page for its frame, its reduced-motion first screen, its heading order, its tab order and its page metadata
rendered frame check: first screen title, untitled sections, lopsided sections, blank stretches, side margins
reduced motion second pass: first screen text hidden when motion is reduced
heading order, tab order and page metadata as one line rules
